about: Medium track claims as executable checks (replaces verdict prose). Each claim is a knob set applied to the current base bot, an expected sign vs the base, and the evidence that made it. `.cache/main/med/scripts/claims.py` re-runs every claim on a new base in one paired experiment and reports which still hold. A claim whose bot lacks a knob is skipped and reported.

claims.note: turning C1 off loses (shipped v50; fresh +66/1,200 vs v44)
news off loses once weights are co-trained (v53)
walking off to hunt costs the farm
